🎥🎬: Night at the Museum (2006)

Larry Daley is a struggling divorced father desperate to prove that he can finally get his life together and become someone his son can admire. When he lands a job as a night security guard at New York’s Museum of Natural History, he expects quiet shifts watching over exhibits. Instead, he discovers that every night, the museum’s displays magically come to life.

From a miniature cowboy named Jedediah to a Roman general, a mischievous monkey, and a towering dinosaur skeleton, Larry suddenly finds himself responsible for keeping an entire museum full of living exhibits under control. But when he learns that the museum’s magical secret is in danger, his job becomes a race against time to protect the exhibits before everything disappears forever.

With history literally coming alive around him, Larry must find the courage to become the father and hero he always wanted to be. Night at the Museum is a magical adventure packed with comedy, unforgettable characters, and the reminder that extraordinary things can happen when you least expect them.

source_details.synopsis: Night at the Museum is a 2006 fantasy comedy film directed by Shawn Levy and written by Robert Ben Garant and Thomas Lennon. It is based on the 1993 children's book by Milan Trenc. The film stars Ben Stiller in the lead role, alongside Carla Gugino, Dick Van Dyke, Mickey Rooney, Bill Cobbs, and Robin Williams. The film follows Larry Daley, a divorced father who applies for a job as a night watchman at New York City's American Museum of Natural History and subsequently discovers that the exhibits come to life at night by a magical Egyptian artifact, and must find a way to keep them under control.
